alex_peopleops: Hi @raj_newhire — quick thread to confirm evidence you'll submit for H-1B extension and who on our side will be the liaison. Need to lock courier and payroll hold plan by Fri 04/12.

raj_newhire: Thanks — timeline is tight. I fly 04/15. Can I still start remotely before stamping?

sofia_immigration: @raj_newhire short answer: yes, with conditions. We must have receipt notice + employer support letter and payroll documented. Full checklist below.

maria_engineering: FYI, team can remote-onboard but laptop shipping needs confirmation if passport required.

alex_peopleops: Checklist (please upload PDFs to secure link): 1) I-797 receipt notice (I-129) 2) Copy of previous I-797 (if any) 3) Passport (bio page + expiration) 4) Most recent I-94 5) Last 3 pay stubs 6) LCA and filing LCA receipt 7) Employer support letter (we'll draft) 8) Job description + training plan 9) Proof of SEVIS/education (if requested) 10) Signed offer + EEO forms.

sofia_immigration: Add: employer must sign travel contingency letter and confirm payroll continuity statement. If consulate interview scheduled, take originals to appointment.

raj_newhire: I have passport and paystubs ready. I need help getting LCA + employer letter — what do you need from me?

alex_peopleops: Send current resume + manager confirmation of duties. We'll generate employer letter and LCA request. Upload to: https://secure-upload.redwood.com/h1b-ext/2056001234 (one-time link). Use subject "H1B_EXT_2056001234".

sofia_immigration: For courier: we recommend FedEx International Priority (tracked), ship to our immigration vendor (details in PM). Label as "ATTN: Immigration Intake — Redwood". Use the invoice template we attach in the channel.

raj_newhire: Can payroll be backdated if there's a stamping delay?

legal_team: Payroll cannot be backdated. We can set a payroll hold policy: start payroll on receipt notice date or after I-94 update. Alex will coordinate with payroll ops.

alex_peopleops: Action items: - @sofia_immigration draft employer letter (due 2056001300) - @raj_newhire upload docs to link (due 2056001272) - @maria_engineering confirm laptop ship without passport (due 2056001290) - @alex_peopleops open payroll case with payroll-ops and set contingency (ticket #HR-8921). Please add scans named as: lastname_docname.pdf.

hr_bot: Ticket HR-8921 created, assignee payroll-ops, due 2056001400. Reminder set.

raj_newhire: Uploaded passport.pdf and paystubs.pdf. LCA? I don't have it.

sofia_immigration: Received. We'll request LCA from payroll/legal — that takes 3-5 business days. If the LCA is pending, we can provisionally start remote onboarding with training-only access (no prod credentials) — acceptable?

maria_engineering: That's fine. We'll grant training GCP sandbox access and delayed prod access until authorization confirmed.

alex_peopleops: One more: travel contingency plan - if stamping delayed beyond 30 days, we will pause start date and set offboarding vs defer policy. We'll confirm SLA once we see receipt.

raj_newhire: Appreciate it. Any docs I should bring to consulate interview?

sofia_immigration: Bring originals: offer letter, employer letter, I-797 receipt, passport, previous I-797 (if any), paystubs, I-94 printout. Also evidence of residence and return intent. We'll PM checklist.

alex_peopleops: Thanks everyone. I’ll post a short summary after Sofia drafts letters.
